summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: How to Make a T-Shirt into a Bunny Girl Costume? ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will focus on creating the fold at the waist for our bunny girl costume. We will cover the process of extending the length of the side, adjusting the fold effects, and making the hemline. --- ## Creating the Fold at the Waist ### Extending the Length To create a horizontal fold at the waist, we need to extend the length of the side. This is achieved by dragging along the original direction while holding the **Ctrl** key. 1. **Drag the Side Panel**: While dragging, ensure to keep the **Ctrl** key pressed. 2. **Input Length**: Enter a specific number for the extension. For example, I have stretched it to **40 mm**, which is approximately **4 cm**. ### Back Panel Adjustment After adjusting the front, extend the back in the same manner by entering the same numerical value. - **Simulate the Extension**: Press the control key briefly to simulate the changes. ### Adjusting the Side Panel Next, we will drag the side panel in the open simulation state. Since the waist is tight, stack the panels near the waist to observe the fold effect more effectively. - **Reduce Particle Diameter**: Decrease the particle diameter of the panel to **5** before simulating. This will allow the grid to be re-placed, making the simulation more accurate. ### Increasing Fabric Friction To prevent the folds from disappearing during simulation: - **Find Fabric in Property Editor**: Increase the friction coefficient of the fabric. This will enhance the friction between the fabric and the virtual model, ensuring that manually created folds remain visible. --- ## Manual Fold Adjustments ### Dragging Folds If we drag more at a time, expect to see more folds. By pulling the panel in the opposite direction, we can adjust the folds as needed. ### Adjusting the Cutting Line In addition to length adjustments, we can also slightly stretch the cutting line in the middle downwards. This creates more fabric to pile on the waist. - **Manual Position Adjustment**: After changing the grid, manually adjust the position to achieve the desired look. ### Making Folds More Obvious To enhance the visibility and stiffness of the folds: - **Increase Fabric Resistance**: Adjust the resistance of the fabric at the waist and the rigidity along the foot line. This will decrease the stretch performance in three directions, making the folds more pronounced. - **Manual Fold Positioning**: To dissipate folds in specific areas, pull them in the opposite direction. --- ## Creating the Hemline ### Selecting Lines for the Hemline Making the hemline is straightforward: 1. **Select Center Line**: Choose the center line, then hold the **Shift** key to select additional lines, ensuring to include the middle section. 2. **Right-click to Create Inner Line**: After selecting all lines, right-click and choose the inner line option. Input the value carefully to avoid exceeding the line limits. ### Fixing the Pins Due to the edge cut, the fixing pins may have been deleted. To recreate them: - **Press the W Key**: Click on the panel and select the two fixing pins. - **Select More Pins**: Hold the **Shift** key to select additional fixing pins, then right-click to fix them on the virtual model. ### Adjusting Fixing Pins Be cautious; the fabric near the fixing pins should not appear too bumpy. - **Add More Fixing Pins**: It’s also possible to fix additional pins on the chest area of the virtual model. --- ## Adjusting the Sewing Lines ### Selecting Sewing Lines The cutting line for many rabbit costumes is quite distinct: 1. **Use the Edge Line Tool**: Select the sewing lines while holding the **Shift** key for additional selection. 2. **Set Folding Angle**: In the property editor, adjust the folding angle. An angle greater than **180 degrees** will bend the sewing line for a more pronounced effect. ### Adjusting for Extra Spaces If there are noticeable gaps at the bottom of the chest during simulation: - **Select Curve Line**: Use the edge line tool to select a small section of the curve line and move it towards the center to tighten the fabric. ### Manual Adjustment Due to grid changes, previous adjustments may shift, necessitating manual readjustments. --- ## Transitioning and Final Adjustments ### Enhancing Fold Effects To achieve a more satisfactory fold effect with the reverse fold method: - **Select Versions**: Choose the relevant versions, right-click, and select shape alter to enhance fold visibility. ### Weakening Fold Effects If the folds are too pronounced, use the edge sewing line tool for moderation. - **Format Template**: After formatting, the folds will maintain their structure during simulations, interacting properly with actions without being modified. --- ## Conclusion Thank you for watching this tutorial. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out! ```
